The treatment system consists of influent screening and grit removal
The Facility includes a 5 million gallon aerated influent equalization basin and a 3.35 million gallon equalization basin
biological removal of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and nitrogen in aerobic, anoxic, and pre-anoxic basins
microfiltration through a membrane bioreactor (MBR)...The immersed membrane filtration process separates suspended solids from the wastewater using a very fine filter (i.e., ultrafilter)
All solids transferred from the biological process to the interchange tanks are first passed through a 250 micron rotary drum screen to remove inert non-biodegradable material
followed by a proprietary sludge digestion process...Solids are periodically removed from the biological process and transferred to two digester tanks, referred to as interchange reactors
digested solids are pumped from the interchange reactor tanks, dosed with polymer for thickening
dewatering via centrifuge, and disposal to a Class III solid waste landfill
All solids are then transported for disposal at Redwood Landfill in Marin County or Hay Road Landfill in Solano County
